versions.subject: Create web_susp_useragents.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    c-useragent|contains:
        # Add more tools as you see fit
        - 'Wfuzz/'
        - 'WPScan v'
        - 'Recon-ng/v'
condition: selection

versions.subject: Feature improvement to add an additional known user agent seen in the wild.
versions.detection:
selection:
    c-useragent|contains:
        # Add more tools as you see fit
        - 'Wfuzz/'
        - 'WPScan v'
        - 'Recon-ng/v'
        - 'GIS - AppSec Team - Project Vision'
condition: selection
versions.spl: "c-useragent" IN ("*Wfuzz/*", "*WPScan v*", "*Recon-ng/v*", "*GIS - AppSec Team - Project Vision*")
